name: Consumable Recipes
description:
Consumable recipes are types of blueprints that unlock buildings, weapons, armour, and food.
They are found around Ashenfall or inside dragonkin vaults. Most recipes are found in chests, while some recipes are rare drops from monsters.

(Quests)
Most quests reward the player with an item or recipe:

(Dragonkin Effigies)
Dragonkin effigies also contain recipes for armour and weapons, however they do not provide a consumable item.
Instead, they hold a knowledge reward token that glows blue—interacting with the statue (and sometimes doing as it requires) will reward the player with the recipe for an item, and then stops glowing.
Any further interactions will say that the player has learned everything from that statue.

(Recipe Books)
Recipe books are exclusively found in Dowdun Reach and teach six new food recipes for the cooking range:

Meat Sandwich
Forager's Sandwich
Steak Sandwich
Meat Twist Sandwich
Glazed Pumpkin Sandwich
Maple Toastie (Awarded as part of the Black Knight's Fortress (quest))

(Fishing Trophies)
Catching each pristine fish unlocks a buildable trophy.
